days.label: Day 1
days.caption: The first reflection installs the skeleton: four states and two rules — bring the cereal, put the bowl away.

days.label: Routine Change
days.caption: The user starts taking medication before eating. The reflector does not append a rule — it rewrites one: sitting down now means deliver the pill, and the cereal moves behind it. The paper's Fig. 7 states this routine change only at the task-label granularity ("Pill to Person"), not as raw FSM sentences the way Days 1–5 are shown; the rule sentences below are a reconstruction in the idiom of Fig. 13.
